instruction: Access the online check-in page for your flight.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from United Airlines homepage to their online check-in page. Uses existing is_expected_url_pattern_match metric to verify the URL pattern. No custom functions needed.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts active tab URL using get_active_url_from_accessTree, which reads from Chrome's accessibility tree and returns {'title': str, 'url': str, 'content': str}
Metric comparison logic correctly performs regex pattern matching on the URL. The metric properly handles both string and dict formats when extracting the URL (chrome.py:78-87)
Data flow is correct: getter returns dict with 'url' field -> metric extracts URL from result['url'] -> pattern matching against 'united.com/en/us/checkin'

Instruction coverage is complete: instruction asks to 'Access the online check-in page for your flight', evaluator verifies URL contains 'united.com/en/us/checkin', which correctly identifies United Airlines check-in page
Expected value is semantically correct: 'united.com/en/us/checkin' is the actual United Airlines check-in page URL, matching the instruction requirement
Edge cases are handled: getter includes retry logic and timeout handling, metric handles both string and dict URL formats
